newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM no comment on Iberia link-up talk.
newsitem.headline: KLM no comment on Iberia link-up talk.

text.p: Dutch flag carrier KLM declined comment on Monday on a potential link up with competitors after the chairman of Iberia said the Spanish company was seeking to head a partnership of European airlines.
"Our policy is not to make any comment on rumours of new KLM partners," spokeswoman Marjolein Wenting told Reuters.
Chairman Xabier de Irala said in an interview published on Monday Iberia was in advanced talks with KLM and was looking at forming an alliance which would also involve Swissair and Alitalia.
"According to analysts, there will be three or four groups left in Europe whose leaders seem clear -- British Airways, Lufthansa and Air France," Irala told financial daily Gaceta de los Negocios.

"Iberia's alternative is either joining one of these groups of forming part of a fourth alliance with KLM, possibly Swissair and also with Alitalia," he said. "We would like to head that project, with the permission of KLM."
Last week KLM chairman Pieter Bouw said the airline was continuing its search for a European partner but said he could make no announcement as there were no "concrete facts".
